DISCUSSION
VOLTAGE - Voltage is the electrical pressure of charge or force that makes charge flow in a circuit. As voltage increases, current also increases, provided resistance stays the same.
DEFINITION
VOLTAGE - Voltage is the electrical pressure or force that makes current flow in a circuit. As voltage increases, current also increases, provided resistance stays the same.
CURRENT - Current is the flow of electrons through an electrical circuit. Current flow increases as voltage increases and decreases as resistance increases.
CURRENT - Current is the flow of electric charge through an electrical circuit. Current increases as voltage increases and decreases as resistance increases.
DEFINITION
RESISTANCE - Resistance is the opposition to current flow. As
